source.verse_hash_method: SHA-256 of exact tab-separated Greek payload, retaining whitespace and variant markers.

key_decisions.rationale: Retains the repeated conditional appeal and four relational grounds.
key_decisions.before: So if there is any encouragement in Christ, any comfort from love, any sharing in the Spirit, any affection and compassion,
key_decisions.after: So if there is any encouragement in Christ, any comfort from love, any sharing in the Spirit, any tenderness and compassion,
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: If then there is any encouragement in Christ, any consolation from love, any sharing in the Spirit, any compassion and mercy,

key_decisions.rationale: Makes the appeal natural while retaining love, soul and repeated common-mindedness.
key_decisions.before: make my joy complete by being of the same mind, having the same love, united in spirit, thinking as one.
key_decisions.after: make my joy complete: think in harmony, share the same love, be united in soul and of one mind.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: make my joy complete: be of the same mind, having the same love, being in full accord and of one mind.

key_decisions.rationale: Preserves the sharp contrast and comparative valuation of others.
key_decisions.before: Do nothing from selfish ambition or empty conceit, but in humility consider others as more important than yourselves.
key_decisions.after: Do nothing out of selfish ambition or empty pride. Instead, in humility regard others as more important than yourselves.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: Do nothing from selfish ambition or conceit, but in humility regard others as better than yourselves.

key_decisions.rationale: Keeps the also of the source rather than denying all concern for one's own needs.
key_decisions.before: Let each of you look not only to your own interests, but also to the interests of others.
key_decisions.after: Each of you should look beyond your own interests to the interests of others as well.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: Let each of you look not to your own interests, but to the interests of others.

key_decisions.rationale: Keeps the communal mindset and connection with Christ; alternative relation is noted.
key_decisions.before: Have this mindset among yourselves, which is also yours in Christ Jesus:
key_decisions.after: Let this be your way of thinking together, the way of Christ Jesus:
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: Let the same mind be in you that was in Christ Jesus,

key_decisions.rationale: Retains form and equality while selecting exploitation with the alternative noted.
key_decisions.before: who, existing in the form of God, did not regard equality with God as something to be exploited,
key_decisions.after: Though he was in the form of God, he did not regard equality with God as something to exploit.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: who, though he was in the form of God, did not regard equality with God as something to be exploited,

key_decisions.rationale: Keeps emptying unexplained and connects it to slave form and human likeness.
key_decisions.before: but emptied himself, taking the form of a servant, becoming like human beings. And being found in human form,
key_decisions.after: Instead, he emptied himself, taking the form of a slave, becoming like human beings. And being found in human form,
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: but emptied himself, taking the form of a servant, being born in human likeness.

key_decisions.rationale: Preserves the downward movement and climactic specification of crucifixion.
key_decisions.before: he humbled himself, becoming obedient to the point of death— even death on a cross.
key_decisions.after: he humbled himself and became obedient to the point of death— even death on a cross.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: And being found in human form, he humbled himself and became obedient to the point of death—even death on a cross.

key_decisions.rationale: Keeps the divine action as response and the unequaled name unnamed here.
key_decisions.before: Therefore God highly exalted him and graciously gave him the name that is above every name,
key_decisions.after: That is why God raised him to the highest place and gave him the name above every name,
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: Therefore God highly exalted him and gave him the name that is above every name,

key_decisions.rationale: Retains the threefold cosmic range rather than compressing it to everyone.
key_decisions.before: so that at the name of Jesus every knee should bend— in heaven, on earth, and under the earth—
key_decisions.after: so that at the name of Jesus every knee should bend— in heaven, on earth and beneath the earth—
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: so that at the name of Jesus every knee should bend, in heaven and on earth and under the earth,

key_decisions.rationale: Preserves confession, the Lord title and its stated divine purpose.
key_decisions.before: and every tongue should confess that Jesus Christ is Lord, to the glory of God the Father.
key_decisions.after: and every tongue confess that Jesus Christ is Lord, to the glory of God the Father.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: and every tongue should confess that Jesus Christ is Lord, to the glory of God the Father.

key_decisions.rationale: Keeps the plural community's work, fear and trembling, and the presence/absence contrast.
key_decisions.before: Therefore, my beloved, just as you have always obeyed—not only when I was present, but now much more in my absence—work out your own salvation with fear and trembling,
key_decisions.after: So then, my beloved, just as you have always obeyed, work out your own salvation with fear and trembling—not only when I am present, but much more now while I am absent.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: Therefore, my beloved, just as you have always obeyed, not only in my presence, but now much more in my absence, work out your own salvation with fear and trembling;

key_decisions.rationale: Makes the two divine workings audible while keeping communal/inward scope open in the note.
key_decisions.before: for God is the one working in you, both to desire and to work for his good pleasure.
key_decisions.after: For God is at work in you—in your willing as well as your doing—for his good pleasure.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: for it is God who is at work in you, enabling you both to will and to work for his good pleasure.

key_decisions.rationale: Keeps the purpose, child identity and light image within the difficult generational language.
key_decisions.before: so that you may be blameless and innocent, children of God without blemish in the midst of a crooked and twisted generation, among whom you shine like lights in the world,
key_decisions.after: so that you may be blameless and innocent, God's children without blemish in the midst of a crooked and distorted generation. Among them you shine like lights in the world,
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: so that you may be blameless and innocent, children of God without blemish in the midst of a crooked and perverse generation, among whom you shine like lights in the world,

key_decisions.rationale: Retains holding/word and the repeated in-vain clauses with an alternative note.
key_decisions.before: holding firmly to the word of life, so that on the day of Christ I may boast that I did not run in vain or labor in vain.
key_decisions.after: holding firmly to the word of life. Then I can boast on the day of Christ that I did not run in vain or labor in vain.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: holding fast to the word of life, so that on the day of Christ I may boast that I did not run in vain or labor in vain.

key_decisions.rationale: Keeps the sacrificial image and communal faith without defining the pouring out as completed death.
key_decisions.before: But even if I am being poured out as a drink offering over the sacrifice and service of your faith, I rejoice and rejoice together with all of you.
key_decisions.after: But even if I am being poured out as a drink offering over the sacrifice and service of your faith, I rejoice and share my joy with all of you.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: But even if I am being poured out as a libation upon the sacrifice and service of your faith, I rejoice and rejoice with all of you;

key_decisions.rationale: Conveys like-souled concern without turning the comparison into a universal judgment.
key_decisions.before: I have no one else like him who will genuinely care about your welfare,
key_decisions.after: I have no one else of his spirit who will take a sincere interest in your welfare.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: For I have no one like him, who will be genuinely concerned for your welfare.

key_decisions.rationale: Keeps proven service, familial comparison and the slave verb without making Paul his master.
key_decisions.before: But you know Timothy's proven character, how, like a child with a parent, he has served with me in the work of the gospel.
key_decisions.after: But you know Timothy's proven character. Like a child with a father, he has served with me as a slave for the good news.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: But you know Timothy’s proven worth, how like a child serving a parent he has served with me in the work of the gospel.

key_decisions.rationale: Keeps all five roles and their distinct relational directions.
key_decisions.before: I considered it necessary to send Epaphroditus back to you—my brother, coworker, and fellow soldier, and your messenger and minister to my need.
key_decisions.after: Still, I thought it necessary to send you Epaphroditus—my brother, fellow worker and fellow soldier, and your messenger and minister to my needs.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: Still, I think it necessary to send to you Epaphroditus—my brother and coworker and fellow soldier, your messenger and minister to my need—

key_decisions.rationale: Preserves his concern over their hearing, not only over illness itself.
key_decisions.before: He has been longing for all of you and has been distressed because you heard that he was ill.
key_decisions.after: He has been longing for all of you and was distressed because you heard that he was ill.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: for he has been longing for all of you and has been distressed because you heard that he was ill.

key_decisions.rationale: Keeps near death, mercy to both people and accumulating grief.
key_decisions.before: He was indeed ill and nearly died. But God had mercy on him, and not only on him but also on me, so that I would not have sorrow upon sorrow.
key_decisions.after: Indeed, he was ill and nearly died. But God had mercy on him, and not only on him but also on me, sparing me sorrow upon sorrow.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: Indeed he was ill, and near to death. But God had mercy on him, and not only on him but also on me, so that I would not have sorrow upon sorrow.

key_decisions.rationale: Makes the epistolary sending natural while retaining both emotional results.
key_decisions.before: So I am all the more eager to send him, so that when you see him again you may rejoice and I may be less anxious.
key_decisions.after: So I am all the more eager to send him, so that seeing him again may bring you joy and lessen my sorrow.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: I am all the more eager to send him, therefore, so that you may rejoice at seeing him again, and that I may be less anxious.

key_decisions.rationale: Keeps risk, Christ's work and the practical lack without alleging their unwillingness.
key_decisions.before: because he came close to death for the work of Christ, risking his life to complete what was lacking in your service to me.
key_decisions.after: because he came close to death for Christ's work, risking his life to provide the service you could not give me.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: because he came close to death for the work of Christ, risking his life to complete what was lacking in your service to me.
